metadata.paper_title: Regression-Based Explainable Deep Learning for Estimating Hamiltonian Parameters from Magnetic Nanodot Images

research_problem.title: Inverse Hamiltonian Parameter Estimation from Magnetic Domain Images
research_problem.description: Accurately inferring atomistic parameters (exchange interactions, DMI, anisotropy, external field) from 2D magnetic domain visualizations of nanodots
key_challenges: Ill-posed inverse problem due to degeneracy
Multiple parameter combinations produce indistinguishable magnetic states
Black-box nature of conventional deep learning models
research_problem.motivation: Understanding and controlling magnetic behavior at nanoscale is crucial for spintronic devices, ultrahigh-density magnetic memories, and neuromorphic computing platforms

methodology.research_approach: Physics-informed machine learning combining atomistic simulations with explainable deep learning
key_innovations: Metropolis-Hastings Monte Carlo sampling with simulated annealing for dataset generation
Extended Heisenberg Hamiltonian framework for accurate thermodynamic modeling
Regression Activation Maps (RAMs) for continuous-valued interpretability
Multi-architecture deep learning framework (CNN and Transformer)
Unsupervised UMAP-based clustering for magnetic phase analysis

nodes.label: VAM-SpinesDL Paper

nodes.label: Inverse Hamiltonian Parameter Estimation
nodes.description: Inferring atomistic magnetic interaction parameters from 2D domain images

nodes.label: Extended Heisenberg Hamiltonian
nodes.description: Generalized magnetic Hamiltonian with exchange, DMI, anisotropy, and Zeeman terms

nodes.label: First-shell Exchange J1
nodes.description: Dominant symmetric exchange interaction (fixed reference: 1.0 meV)

nodes.label: Second-shell Exchange J2
nodes.description: Secondary shell exchange pathway modulating domain-scale collinearity

nodes.label: Third-shell Exchange J3
nodes.description: Third neighbor shell exchange (energetically dominated by J1, J2)

nodes.label: Fourth-shell Exchange J4
nodes.description: Fourth neighbor shell exchange (energetically dominated by J1, J2)

nodes.label: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya Interaction (DMI/KDM)
nodes.description: Antisymmetric spin-orbit coupling driving chiral, non-collinear spin winding
nodes.physical_role: Stabilizes helical, skyrmion-like, and labyrinthine textures

nodes.label: Zeeman Field (Hex)
nodes.description: External magnetic field coupling to localized spins along x-direction
nodes.physical_role: Primary thermodynamic driver for macroscopic phase transitions

nodes.label: Bulk Magnetocrystalline Anisotropy (Kan1)
nodes.description: Directional preference for magnetization in bulk lattice sites

nodes.label: Surface Magnetocrystalline Anisotropy (KanS)
nodes.description: Enhanced directional preference at nanodot boundary due to broken inversion symmetry
nodes.note: Typically larger magnitude than bulk anisotropy

nodes.label: Annealing Temperature (T0)
nodes.description: Initial temperature for simulated annealing; governs degree of spin order

nodes.label: Metropolis-Hastings Monte Carlo Sampling
nodes.description: Stochastic algorithm for sampling thermodynamic distribution and simulated annealing

nodes.label: Simulated Annealing
nodes.description: Temperature-controlled cooling schedule to find global energy minimum

nodes.label: Image-Based Magnetic Dataset Generation
nodes.description: Systematic generation of thermodynamically relaxed 2D magnetization field images
steps: Geometry parsing via circular lattice mask
Spin state mapping via sz projection
Image rendering with divergent red-blue colormap
No spatial augmentation to preserve chiral symmetry

nodes.label: Magnetic Nanodot Geometry
nodes.description: Cylindrical nanodot with confined dimensions

nodes.label: ResNet50 (Residual Networks)
nodes.description: Convolutional neural network with residual shortcuts for parameter regression
nodes.advantage: Enables very deep networks while mitigating vanishing gradients

nodes.label: DenseNet121 (Densely Connected Networks)
nodes.description: Convolutional network with dense feature concatenation
nodes.key_mechanism: Feature concatenation across all preceding layers
nodes.advantage: Maximizes information flow and reuse for multi-scale analysis

performance.notes: Mentioned as achieving strongest overall performance in preliminary results

nodes.label: Xception (Extreme Inception)
nodes.description: Depthwise separable convolution architecture for efficient feature extraction
nodes.advantage: Efficient decoupling of spatial and cross-channel correlations

performance.notes: Lowest absolute prediction errors; highest MAE for DMI and second-shell exchange

nodes.label: Vision Transformer (ViT-B/16)
nodes.description: Patch-based transformer architecture for capturing long-range spatial dependencies
nodes.advantage: Captures long-range global correlations across nanodot

performance.notes: Superior variance-explained but not tightest absolute errors

nodes.label: Shared Regression Head
nodes.description: Common output layer shared across all architectures
components: Dense output layer (8 units, linear activation)
nodes.purpose: Mitigate overfitting in high-dimensional parameter space

nodes.label: Regression Activation Maps (RAMs)
nodes.description: Novel gradient-based attribution method for continuous-valued regression in physical systems
nodes.key_innovation: Extends activation mapping from classification to regression
nodes.gradient_computation: Global averaging of gradients w.r.t. feature maps
nodes.normalization: Global cross-layer normalization across all parameters and layers
advantages: Bridges latent representations to observed phenomena

nodes.label: RAMs for CNN-based Approaches
nodes.description: RAMs formulation for convolutional neural networks
nodes.spatial_importance: Globally pooled gradients of error objective

nodes.label: RAMs for Vision Transformer Approaches
nodes.description: RAMs extension for attention-based architectures via token reshaping
nodes.token_sequence: Isolated spatial tokens from terminal encoder
nodes.pseudo_feature_map: A_ViT reshaped to sqrt(Nr) x sqrt(Nr) x D
nodes.advantage: Fair comparison across fundamentally different architectures

nodes.label: Magnetic Phase Categories
nodes.description: Unsupervised clustering of latent representations via UMAP
nodes.key_finding: Ordered low-temperature regimes show substantially higher accuracy; high-temperature disorder concentrates bulk of residual error

nodes.label: UMAP (Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection)
nodes.description: Unsupervised dimensionality reduction for latent space visualization
nodes.application: Clustering magnetization field patterns into physical phase categories
nodes.key_result: Identifies 4 physically meaningful magnetic phase clusters

nodes.label: Chiral Domain Walls
nodes.description: Degenerate topological features with non-collinear spin winding
nodes.physical_significance: Governed primarily by DMI and exchange competition

nodes.label: Skyrmion Cores
nodes.description: Topologically protected spin defects with high spatial chirality

nodes.label: Labyrinthine Domain Pattern
nodes.description: Stripe-like domains with regular spacing and chiral winding

nodes.label: Mean Squared Error (MSE) Loss
nodes.description: Primary loss function for network optimization
nodes.role: Mitigates influence of outlier topological states

nodes.label: Adam Optimizer
nodes.description: Adaptive learning rate optimizer for gradient-based training
nodes.reason: Well-established sensitivity of transformers and CNNs to aggressive learning rates

nodes.label: ReduceLROnPlateau Learning Rate Scheduler
nodes.description: Dynamic learning rate reduction on validation loss plateau

nodes.label: EarlyStopping
nodes.description: Halts training on validation loss plateau with best weight restoration

nodes.label: Dataset Partitioning Strategy
nodes.description: Rigorous two-stage random split for train/val/test separation
nodes.purpose: Prevent information leakage and ensure topological independence

nodes.label: Image Preprocessing
nodes.description: Normalization and dimensional transformation for network input
nodes.reason: Leverage ImageNet pretrained hierarchical spatial filters

nodes.label: Target Variable Preprocessing
nodes.description: Min-Max normalization of physical parameters
nodes.training_set_basis: Statistics computed from training set only
nodes.purpose: Numerical stability and support for bounded RAMs objective

nodes.label: Coefficient of Determination (R²)
nodes.description: Proportion of variance in physical parameter successfully captured

nodes.label: Mean Absolute Error (MAE)
nodes.description: Absolute magnitude of prediction error
